hero.sub: The podcast on business, economy, entrepreneurship and technology. An Andorran perspective with a global outlook, with AI as the connecting thread.

naming.sub: Valira Valley is no accident. It's the sum of two powerful references: a place of origin and the world's leading reference for innovation.
naming.valira_def: The Valira river — the main artery of the Principality of Andorra. Origin, identity and territorial roots.
naming.valley_def: Silicon Valley — the world's leading reference for technology, innovation and entrepreneurship.
